setting: retrospective four-way cross-fitting, not global label blindness
per_model_scope: each eta_fold is fitted only on three other class folds after excluding every connected-photo component touching its held fold
label_access_clarification: the four independently fitted models together use labels from all four folds as training data for other models; no held-fold labels enter that fold model or its forecast
held_outcome_evaluation_order: all four prediction.json files were saved before actual held I/U evaluation
known_prior_exposure: all4000 GT had already been scored and C12 globally selected before this diagnostic
